Starting the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, capturing screenshots along the way.

I have completed the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. 

The site features excellent visual design and data presentation (especially the MLB grid and Economics heatmap), but suffers from significant data filtering and sorting issues on the primary discovery feeds. 

**Key findings include:**
- A critical bug where the Sports feed is flooded with resolved markets showing 100%/0% probabilities.
- Sorting issues where championship futures display the 0% longshots instead of the favorites.
- The Golf grid and Weather map fail to load their data, remaining stuck in skeleton states.
- The NHL grid displays mathematically impossible data (multiple teams at 100% to win the championship).

I have compiled the full findings, scores, and actionable recommendations into the attached `audit_report.md` file, along with annotated screenshots documenting the issues and the successful pages.
